title: [Console] help in --shell repeats on subsequent help commands
body:
Hi,

Entering --shell mode on the console and then running a help command shows the correct help, but then if you try a different help command it shows the first again every time.

Example;

``` sh
chrissedlmayr$ app/console --shell

      _____                  __                  ___
     / ____|                / _|                |__ \
    | (___  _   _ _ __ ___ | |_ ___  _ __  _   _   ) |
     \___ \| | | | '_ ` _ \|  _/ _ \| '_ \| | | | / /
     ____) | |_| | | | | | | || (_) | | | | |_| |/ /_
    |_____/ \__, |_| |_| |_|_| \___/|_| |_|\__, |____|
             __/ |                          __/ |
            |___/                          |___/


Welcome to the Symfony shell (2.0.11 - app/dev/debug).

At the prompt, type help for some help,
or list to get a list of available commands.

To exit the shell, type ^D.

Symfony > help assetic:dump
Usage:
 assetic:dump [--watch] [--force] [--period="..."] [write_to]

Arguments:
 write_to  Override the configured asset root

Options:
 --watch   Check for changes every second, debug mode only
 --force   Force an initial generation of all assets (used with --watch)
 --period  Set the polling period in seconds (used with --watch) (default: 1)

Symfony > help container:debug
Usage:
 assetic:dump [--watch] [--force] [--period="..."] [write_to]

Arguments:
 write_to  Override the configured asset root

Options:
 --watch   Check for changes every second, debug mode only
 --force   Force an initial generation of all assets (used with --watch)
 --period  Set the polling period in seconds (used with --watch) (default: 1)

Symfony > help router:debug
Usage:
 assetic:dump [--watch] [--force] [--period="..."] [write_to]

Arguments:
 write_to  Override the configured asset root

Options:
 --watch   Check for changes every second, debug mode only
 --force   Force an initial generation of all assets (used with --watch)
 --period  Set the polling period in seconds (used with --watch) (default: 1)

Symfony > 

```
